localEnvironmentProbe.note: Local DB quality cannot be proven until Supabase credentials match deployed environment.

modelSwitchCheck.note: Structured deliverables can be pointed at Opus if Anthropic provider env is configured; Claw chat now defaults to OpenClaw safeclaw profile with OpenAI OAuth instead of Anthropic SDK.

clawChatRoute.harnessPriority: Prompt injects run_safeclaw_harness_agent first and forbids evidence outside the DB harness packet.
clawChatRoute.vercelCaveat: Vercel functions cannot read the user local OpenClaw OAuth profile unless OpenClaw runtime/Gateway is installed and authenticated in that environment.

vercelEnvCheck.note: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in Vercel can support Claude deliverables only when AI_DELIVERABLES_PROVIDER and ANTHROPIC_MODEL are set; Claw chat defaults to OpenClaw/OpenAI OAuth instead.
